args.command: cat package.json && ls node_modules/nanoid/package.json >/dev/null && echo "nanoid installed"
node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/nanoid/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null || cat node_modules/nanoid/package.json | head -5; ls package-lock.json 2>/dev/null
grep -m1 '"version"' node_modules/nanoid/package.json; node -e "import('nanoid').then(m => console.log('import ok:', typeof m.nanoid))"
head -10 node_modules/nanoid/package.json; echo "---"; node --input-type=module -e "import { nanoid } from 'nanoid'; console.log('sample id:', nanoid())"
